BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Money as rumours only.
   C. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money.

2. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.

   D. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   C. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.

   A. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.

   A. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.

   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

13. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
